title: Angular-time evolution and edge-spin dynamics in the Haldane phase of the S=1 bilinear-biquadratic chain
summary: We investigate the angular-time evolution -- a parameter-time evolution generated by the entanglement Hamiltonian -- for the bipartitioned ground state of the S=1 bilinear-biquadratic chain under the open boundary condition with the up edge spin.
